status_definitions.CONFIRMED: Only the specifically cited documentation, vendor capability or implementation fact; never implicit flight acceptance.
status_definitions.TBC: Applicability, selection or conflict requires confirmation.
status_definitions.TBD: Not established in reviewed evidence; null is unknown, never zero.
status_definitions.ASSUMED: Design prediction, analytical input or legacy/model assumption.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 flight candidate and raw channel roles

candidates.value: One VN-100 Rugged IMMU; raw gyro and internal magnetometer feed own estimator in B3; I1 also publishes acceleration

decision_register.conflict: Documented selection is not delivered/installed acceptance; accelerometer use and tracker feedback policy unresolved.
decision_register.simulation_note: Retain candidate identity and raw-channel intent only. Need part/serial/firmware/BOM, wiring and configuration readback before flight-like use.

decision_register.decision: External magnetometer inventory
decision_register.conflict: Plural magnetometers/separate test headings do not prove additional devices; three axes are one triad.
decision_register.simulation_note: Do not instantiate a separate external magnetometer without BOM, physical location, channel map and role.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 transport, framing and serial speed

candidates.value: LVTTL UART (electrical); UART/RS-232 full duplex, 115200 default, 8 data bits/1 stop bit (detailed); I2C register manager (software)
RS-422 TBR
UART1 RS-232; UART2 3 V TTL; each 9600-921600

decision_register.conflict: I2C and RS-422 descriptions conflict with model-specific serial interfaces. 115200 is described as a default, not verified register state.
decision_register.simulation_note: Resolve connector pins/transceiver/port, packet fields, firmware settings, binary/ASCII format and clock data. Do not infer acquisition rate from baud.

decision_register.decision: Configured sensor/control output rates and filters

candidates.value: 10 Hz IMU and sun-manager sampling/application schedule; GYRO_RANGE, ACCEL_RANGE, DLPF_CONFIG and SAMPLE_RATE_DIV have no supplied values
5 Hz estimate-control-actuate tick; 200 ms deadline

decision_register.conflict: Specific 10 Hz ICD intent is stronger interface evidence than outdated SW1, but no approved disposition; device sample, output packet, manager and estimator rates remain distinct.
decision_register.simulation_note: Need actual output-rate/filter readback and approved schedule; never set flight sensors to the hardware maximum or change the existing 0.1 s plant.

decision_register.decision: Sun sensor model and physical count

candidates.value: TensorCSS-10: PDR 2; I1 three physical/manager channels; B1 mass-budget 6
Four SLCD61N8 coarse sun sensors

decision_register.conflict: 2/3/6 TensorCSS-10 versus 4 SLCD61N8; a software channel mask or budget quantity does not prove populated hardware. TensorCSS-10S is a vendor variant, not established selection.
decision_register.simulation_note: Obtain installed BOM, photographs, PCB channel population and deployment configuration. Retain all candidates.

decision_register.decision: Sun sensor ADC, intensity/vector and calibration interface

candidates.value: MCP3204/3208 SPI ADC, 12-bit; 3 channels at 10 Hz; scale/offset names 0-5, CHANNEL_MASK default 0x3F, raw U16[6], calibrated F32[3]
Analog irradiance-correlated output; ADC external, 0-2.4 V feature range

decision_register.conflict: Three-channel descriptions conflict with six-channel fields. Manager publishes intensities while filter input calls the data a body-frame Sun vector; inversion and mounting transform are not defined.
decision_register.simulation_note: Resolve exact ADC/channel/reference/gain/filter/scan order and intensity-to-vector algorithm; a port name does not prove a calibrated vector measurement.

decision_register.decision: LOST and FOUND camera/lens selection and ADCS role

candidates.value: Table: xiC MC031CG-SY; mechanical: MC031MG-SY-FL; software: MC031MG-SY. FOUND Edmund Cr 6 mm f/4; LOST Cr 16 mm f/16
LOST independently estimates attitude for payload characterization; FOUND uses an attitude input to estimate position

decision_register.conflict: Budgets retain xiQ-S7 and older MDD/ICD table-of-contents camera names; obsolete SW1 routes LOST/FOUND as truth to ADCS.
decision_register.simulation_note: Treat payload algorithms separately from spacecraft estimator. No approved current LOST-to-ADCS update path established; FOUND is not an independent full-attitude input.

decision_register.decision: Sagitta versus Twinkle and truth independence

candidates.value: Arcsec Sagitta attitude truth measure; B3 excludes it from the credited flight attitude estimate
AttitudeFilter accepts absolute quaternion from StarTrackerManager; PAY StarTrackerManager text names Arcsec Twinkle, manual v11.5
LOST/FOUND truth correction in Kalman update

decision_register.conflict: Truth-only Sagitta versus tracker feedback are incompatible validation policies until source, mode and estimator boundaries are stated; Twinkle software text is stale relative to Sagitta hardware table.
decision_register.simulation_note: Decide data ownership and feedback policy. If a tracker enters the filter, its same measurements cannot provide independent validation of that filter.

decision_register.decision: Camera/tracker interfaces and capture settings

candidates.value: Camera table USB2.0/hub/BBB versus CameraManager USB3.0 hardware description; trigger IN active high, OUT active low. Sagitta full-duplex RS-485 transceived to UART; CSP in Twinkle prose versus NSP/SLIP in data table

decision_register.conflict: No confirmed exposure duration/output cadence, synchronization wiring/firmware readback or tracker protocol disposition.
decision_register.simulation_note: Preserve specified signal polarities as interface intent only; verify edges against exposure/strobe and actual tracker model. Do not infer sample epochs from USB/serial receipt.

decision_register.decision: Physical body axes and datum

candidates.value: R1 CAL2.2.1 geometric-center coordinate-system obligation

decision_register.conflict: Geometric center need not equal COM; code X/Y/Z labels do not identify installed spacecraft faces.
decision_register.simulation_note: Require released right-handed body frame, origin and optical/mechanical datums before any C_SB or boresight is instantiated.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 sensor-to-body transform and polarity

candidates.value: Payload lateral-plate mounting; numeric C_SB, position, positive-axis/polarity map, survey/calibration residual all TBD
Runtime C_SB=identity only; S=B

decision_register.conflict: Vendor housing alignment/cross-axis errors are not as-built HS-2 mounting errors; no identity transform is released.
decision_register.simulation_note: Get sensor-datum definition plus CAD/as-built survey and channel-specific calibration. Keep current simulation identity explicitly ASSUMED.

decision_register.decision: Sun-sensor boresights, deployment and sign convention

candidates.value: I1 locations: solar +X, solar +Y, FOUND camera; no numeric boresights/mount matrices
Deployed solar-panel axes approximately 30 deg from an unspecified spacecraft axis
TensorCSS zenith is local +Z; output correlated with irradiance and incident angle

decision_register.conflict: Different models/counts/deployed geometries; no released face-to-body mapping, sign/ADC channel association or calibrated array response.
decision_register.simulation_note: Need design normals, deployed geometry, as-built vector survey and illumination response per channel. A one-axis intensity cannot be substituted for a measured three-axis Sun vector.

decision_register.decision: Payload relative mounting versus calibrated optical transforms

candidates.value: FOUND 90 +/-1 from LOST; FOUND face +X/-X/+Y/-Y pending. LOST lateral plate; Sagitta four lateral-plate brackets

candidates.units: C_camera_B; C_tracker_B; pixel/optical-axis signs; calibrated uncertainty

decision_register.conflict: 90 +/-1 is physical placement requirement, not alignment-knowledge accuracy. No complete nominal, surveyed or calibrated body/optical transform.
decision_register.simulation_note: Keep mechanical design intent, CAD, assembled survey, optical calibration and thermal change separate.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 gyro range and resolution
decision_register.conflict: MDD 400 conflicts with model-specific +/-2000 capability; neither establishes actual configured register or estimator rate limit.
decision_register.simulation_note: Use +/-2000 and 0.02 only as labeled vendor capability priors in a separately authorized component study.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 gyro stochastic specifications

candidates.value: Cover summarizes 5-7 deg/h typical; detailed Table 3 gives 5 typical / 10 maximum

decision_register.conflict: In-run stability is not initial bias, a random-walk coefficient, or a covariance; cover/table summary differs.
decision_register.simulation_note: Do not copy density into per-sample standard deviation. Need PSD convention, effective filter bandwidth, decimation/correlations and measured Allan/bias data.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 gyro sampling and cross-axis capability

candidates.confidence: Cross-axis sensitivity as stated, not percent
Maximum capability, not selected packet rate

decision_register.conflict: Hardware sampling/bandwidth do not define selected output/filter settings or inter-axis installed alignment.
decision_register.simulation_note: Retain units as published; no generated misalignment distribution or sample-rate substitution.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 internal magnetometer capability
decision_register.conflict: Not local-field cleanliness limit, installed bias/noise or flight acquisition rate.
decision_register.simulation_note: No magnetic bias, hard/soft-iron matrix, filter, latency or post-burst recovery can be inferred from these numbers.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 accelerometer capability and orbital role
decision_register.conflict: I1 carries acceleration but does not define its attitude-estimator role; terrestrial AHRS aiding assumptions do not establish an orbital gravity reference.
decision_register.simulation_note: In free fall an accelerometer measures specific force, not the local gravity direction. Do not use it as a second attitude vector without an applicable measurement model.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 onboard AHRS performance versus own raw-sensor estimator

candidates.confidence: RMS; conditional magnetic environment/calibration; dynamic aiding caveat

decision_register.conflict: B3 explicitly uses raw sensors and own estimator. Vendor AHRS results and mounting specifications are different quantities from HS-2 knowledge.
decision_register.simulation_note: Do not use 2/0.5/1 deg as HS-2 filter noise, accuracy or total pointing. Orbital free-fall applicability and truth independence require separate evidence.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 installed calibration, filtering and thermal residuals

candidates.value: Manufacturer states bias/scale/misalignment/gyro g-sensitivity calibration across -40 to +85 C; hard/soft-iron compensation available

candidates.units: bias; scale; covariance; noise PSD; random walk; temperature residual; calibration coefficients

decision_register.conflict: Factory calibration statement is not a serial-number certificate or mounted HS-2 error map. Dynamic magnetic interference is not removed by a generic static calibration.
decision_register.simulation_note: Obtain serial-specific calibration/readback, zero-rate and temperature records, rate-table scale/cross-axis data and installed hard/soft-iron/dynamic magnetic tests.

decision_register.decision: TensorCSS angular response, FOV and output specifications

candidates.confidence: Typical error, no sigma/RMS confidence specified
Normal-incidence value under AM0 solar simulator

decision_register.conflict: Scalar intensity/angle response depends on irradiance; FOV is not whole-array coverage. Not applicable to unconfirmed SLCD61N8 alternative.
decision_register.simulation_note: Vendor response envelope may support a future candidate study; no automatic Gaussian 5-deg noise or flight-calibrated vector reconstruction.

decision_register.decision: TensorCSS thermal limits and response calibration

candidates.value: Feature list calls -40 to +100 operating; I1 thermal table repeats that wider range
Temperature compensation described; unit-specific response report/lookup and coefficients for installed sensors not located

decision_register.conflict: Detailed vendor table distinguishes operation from survival even though feature prose conflicts. Datasheet example at 60 C is not a unit calibration.
decision_register.simulation_note: Use vendor limits as priors, preserve conflicting prose; characterize mounted response, dark offset, gain, temperature, irradiance/albedo and ADC chain before selecting coefficients.

decision_register.decision: Missing sensor performance dimensions

candidates.units: bias; bias instability; random walk; scale factor; cross-axis residual; saturation/recovery; latency; filtering; calibration uncertainty

decision_register.conflict: No complete installed performance characterization found for gyro/internal mag/CSS; external sensor identity unresolved; optical performance budgets are assumptions.
decision_register.simulation_note: Coverage matrix below explicitly distinguishes published capability from missing installed quantities; unknown is never assigned zero.

decision_register.decision: LOST/FOUND optical FOV configuration

candidates.value: FOUND 110-140

decision_register.conflict: Camera/lens variants and FOV values differ; no measured flight-lens/boresight response package.
decision_register.simulation_note: Do not derive accepted target visibility or total pointing allowance from an arbitrarily chosen FOV.

decision_register.decision: Acquisition, publication, receipt and estimator epoch

candidates.value: I1 per-source timestamps/freshness getters; serial latency below one control period; numeric acquisition aperture, timestamp origin, clock offset/jitter, age limits and estimator target epoch TBD

decision_register.conflict: Timestamp presence does not define physical acquisition epoch; cached gyro/sun/tracker can belong to different times. No MAX_STALE_TICKS_FATAL value established.
decision_register.simulation_note: Specify clock domains, acquisition start/mid/end, output readiness, receipt, propagation/update epoch, stale/out-of-sequence handling and admissible sample age.

decision_register.decision: VN-100 synchronization hardware capability

candidates.confidence: Specification; not end-to-end installed timestamp error

candidates.value: SYNC_IN can synchronize measurements or output; SYNC_OUT can indicate ADC/IMU/attitude availability; configurable edges/modes/skip factors

decision_register.conflict: Flight wiring/configuration and timestamp-to-exposure relationship unverified.
decision_register.simulation_note: Do not use 20 us as flight latency/jitter or assume sync pins are wired. Request oscilloscope/logic traces and register readback.

decision_register.decision: Magnetic measurement validity during actuation

candidates.value: Burst then idle intended; valid aperture, contamination allocation, settling, current decay, recovery and sample/filter history unknown

decision_register.conflict: Zero command/current is not proof of an uncontaminated field; unknown filter history may straddle actuation.
decision_register.simulation_note: Keep current diagnostic cycle TEST-ONLY. Hardware characterization must establish clean acquisition history and validity flags; do not invent a quiet duration.

decision_register.decision: Current simulation sensor/navigation timing boundary

candidates.value: Continuous: ideal truth SimpleNav and aligned ideal TAM on 0.1 s plant/sensor/control clock. Diagnostic: TAM/nav snapshot at 0.4 s offset, compute at 0.5 s, actuation at 0.6 s in a 1.0 s TEST-ONLY cycle

decision_register.conflict: Software timing is explicit and repaired; it is not real gyro propagation or a physical sensor aperture/filter/latency model.
decision_register.simulation_note: No runtime changes. Retain truth/measured/estimated distinctions and following-interval command timing. Old audit timing-defect paragraphs at 833b015 are historical.

decision_register.decision: Current AttitudeFilter interface definition

candidates.value: Caches valid IMU, sun-vector and star-tracker data with independent timestamps; returns quaternion/rate/angular acceleration and previous B

decision_register.conflict: Names estimated attitude/filter do not define propagation, fusion, estimator state, noise/covariance or initialization; current B producer missing from listed IMU payload.
decision_register.simulation_note: Current intent supports designing interfaces/freshness decisions only. No current complete algorithm, code revision or executed estimator test is established by these sources.

decision_register.decision: Own raw-sensor attitude estimator intent

candidates.value: Raw VN-100 gyro/magnetometer plus CSS; Sagitta independent truth; nominal 10 arcsec knowledge prediction

decision_register.conflict: Own estimator named but no algorithm/equations/state/Q/R/P0/initialization/update schedule supplied; tracker-feedback policy conflicts with I1.
decision_register.simulation_note: Agree estimator measurement ownership, propagation/reference frame, state and bias strategy before implementation. Prediction is not achieved knowledge.

decision_register.decision: Kalman filter proposal

candidates.value: Passive StateEstimator run_filter at 5 Hz; prediction unless LOST/FOUND truth updated, then correction; no Kalman variant or covariance definition

decision_register.conflict: Source explicitly outdated; updates described as else-to-prediction leave propagation detail unresolved. No evidence selecting EKF versus MEKF.
decision_register.simulation_note: Retain as obsolete proposal, not current flight implementation. Do not fill missing equations/gains/covariance from convention.

decision_register.decision: TRIAD, QUEST/q-method, complementary, EKF/MEKF selection

candidates.value: No explicit current HS-2 selection found for TRIAD, QUEST/q-method, complementary filter, EKF or MEKF in reviewed current evidence

decision_register.conflict: Generic Kalman language does not establish a variant; naming an algorithm here would be a new engineering decision.
decision_register.simulation_note: Architecture trade/design can begin now, but flight selection and implementation are blocked. This bounded review does not prove no software exists elsewhere.

decision_register.decision: Vendor AHRS and legacy reference are not flight-estimator evidence

candidates.value: VN-100 proprietary AHRS Kalman/VPE with gyro-bias compensation and magnetic/acceleration rejection
Standalone gyro propagation plus one magnetic-vector correction/bias scaffold; truth magnetic reference; historical unvalidated gains

decision_register.conflict: Vendor AHRS is not B3 own raw-sensor estimator; historical standalone reference is not a released onboard implementation or independent accuracy test.
decision_register.simulation_note: Do not promote either model or its gains into the runtime configuration.

decision_register.decision: TensorCSS temperature response specifications

candidates.confidence: Vendor table; gain error footnote assumes temperature compensation

decision_register.conflict: The 100 C specification condition is not permission to operate at 100 C; detailed operational limit remains 70 C. T0 and installed unit response are missing.
decision_register.simulation_note: Preserve vendor compensation form V_comp = V_out - alpha*(T-T0); do not load the example curve or nominal coefficient as HS-2 calibration.

decision_register.decision: Spacecraft estimator knowledge requirement versus budget inputs

candidates.confidence: Common 3-sigma or bounded-equivalent budget basis; not measured distribution
Budget 3-sigma context; input provenance/three-axis meaning not established

decision_register.conflict: 10 arcsec spacecraft prediction and 5 arcsec FOUND input describe different chains; no architecture/data-product mapping establishes both. Neither replaces RVM TBD.
decision_register.simulation_note: Approve estimate error frame, per-axis/full-attitude metric, mode/rate envelope, confidence, time window and truth source. No credible knowledge accuracy can yet be estimated.

decision_register.decision: Sensor-to-body alignment knowledge

candidates.confidence: Common budget confidence; bounded alignment term

decision_register.conflict: Written 3-deg knowledge bound and tighter budget numbers are not measured mounting errors or approved supersession.
decision_register.simulation_note: Separate mounting tolerance from calibrated alignment knowledge and estimator residual; no arbitrary Gaussian distribution.

decision_register.decision: LOST-to-FOUND relative alignment knowledge
decision_register.conflict: Conflicting entries in the same RVM; 90 +/-1 physical mounting angle is a different requirement.
decision_register.simulation_note: Retain both knowledge values and flags; obtain source-owner disposition plus relative boresight survey.

decision_register.decision: Camera-to-truth alignment knowledge

candidates.value: FOUND/TM 0.04 TBR; LOST/TM TBD
FOUND/TM 0.1 TBR; other passages 0.05 or TBD

candidates.confidence: Budget bounded term includes tracker accuracy and residual alignment

decision_register.conflict: Distinct camera pairs and integrated tracker+alignment terms cannot be treated as the same error or counted twice.
decision_register.simulation_note: Resolve exact pairs and measurement frame; distinguish sensor accuracy, payload boresight calibration and thermoelastic change.

decision_register.decision: LOST algorithm accuracy and truth chain

candidates.confidence: Budget assigned terms, not completed measured results

candidates.value: Older minimum-success passages: 180 cross / 360 around; different full-success tiers

decision_register.conflict: B3 is an unverified budget, not a Sagitta serial-specific vendor/test certificate; payload algorithm accuracy is not spacecraft control pointing.
decision_register.simulation_note: Preserve axes, success tier, confidence and reference chain. No combination into an achieved pointing number.

decision_register.decision: Image synchronization versus angular error allocation

candidates.value: FOUND/truth less than +/-10; FOUND/GNSS less than +/-65

candidates.confidence: Common budget confidence assumptions; not measured latency

decision_register.conflict: Time synchronization, angular allocation, transport latency and estimator sample age are different terms; clock/exposure definitions are unverified.
decision_register.simulation_note: Define exposure midpoint and clock mapping with signed offset/jitter measurements. Angular sample-age error is approximately omega times delta-t for small motion, not a fixed pointing number.

decision_register.decision: Control accuracy and keep-out are separate from attitude knowledge

candidates.value: RVM 20 deg pointing; B3 10 deg; budgets 15 deg allocation; older derivations 42 TBR / 43 deg
RVM Sun keep-out >=55 when cameras on; R2/T2 >=70; legacy Twinkle note 90; payload fields TBD
Experiment rate <0.5 TBC; ICD slew ceiling 0.04, parent requirement unresolved

decision_register.conflict: Limits and confidence/applicability are unresolved; none defines estimator accuracy or proves tracker/Sun-sensor availability.
decision_register.simulation_note: Keep control error, acquisition geometry and sensor knowledge separate. Do not implement pointing or convert assumed budget predictions into requirements.

decision_register.decision: Completed installed sensor/estimator measurements
decision_register.conflict: Procedures, tracker entries, vendor factory assertions and budget MC/HIL assertions are not executed HS-2 measured evidence.
decision_register.simulation_note: No completed measured installed gyro/magnetic/CSS/alignment/timing/estimator/SIL-HIL performance result was located in this bounded review. Request records; do not assert none exists elsewhere.

frame_contract.simulation: N is Earth-centered ICRF/J2000; B is the mathematical simulation body. sigma_BN represents B relative to N, C_BN maps N components to B. For a sensor S, C_SB maps B to S, so b_S=C_SB*C_BN*b_N and b_B=C_SB^T*b_S for a proper rotation. The existing identity C_SB is explicitly ASSUMED and enforced by config validation.

observability_analysis.classification: Independent engineering inference; not released HS-2 mode logic
observability_analysis.basis: For one known inertial vector b_N with measurement b_S=C_SB*C_BN*b_N, the attitude Jacobian is proportional to the vector cross-product matrix, rank two for a nonzero vector: rotation about that vector is instantaneously unobservable. Two correctly timed/calibrated non-collinear vector directions can locally constrain attitude; conditioning degrades near collinearity. A photodiode intensity is not by itself a full direction. Gyros propagate an initialized attitude but do not supply an absolute orientation or guarantee bias observability. Temporal field variation can improve observability under an appropriate dynamic model/excitation; it is not an instantaneous guarantee. Accelerometers in free fall cannot be treated as a terrestrial gravity-direction aid.

source_boundary: Committed D1-D5 and current C1-C3 were inspected first at the stated baseline commit. Historical 833b015 timing/ExtForceTorque statements in audit tables are not current defects; current code and later addenda define the repaired software behavior.

Drive reads were limited to nine exact sensor/interface/budget/procedure documents and two targeted folders already grounded in Husky Satellite Lab, 0AC8raEVvalZjUk9PVA. Every fetched result reported that Drive ID. No My Drive or all-Drive search, unrelated document fetch, Drive write, web research or repeated broad audit was performed.

Targeted folders: ADCS Component listed only obsolete SW1; Subsystem Testing listed nine documents, of which the ADCS and payload procedures were read. These bounded listings are not proof that no other implementation or test exists elsewhere.
R1/R2/M1/B1/P1/T1/I2/S2/OP1 facts were reused through their committed audit registers, not claimed as a new inspection of those originals. Their current revisions have not been reverified.

Engineering revision/approval controls authority, not Drive modification time. I3's 2026-09-29 revision-history date is future-dated at this 2026-09-07 review. I1 remains unsigned and explicitly notes software inaccuracies.

Fetched H5 is a stored text transcription with modified time 2026-07-28 but internal 2025-08 revision; H4 current metadata says 2026-03-21, unlike the older audit's metadata observation. These metadata differences do not establish changed component performance or override document revision.

CONFIRMED means exactly the cited statement/capability/implementation fact. Selection intent, vendor performance, design prediction, an approved obligation and installed calibration remain separate. Null is unknown, never zero. All structured evidence remains runtime_usable:false.

terms.quantifiable_today: Vendor gyro/magnetic capabilities and B3 10/5 arcsec predictions can be tabulated separately, but no HS-2 estimator error distribution or achieved bound is supported.
3-deg documented knowledge bound and 0.250/0.500-deg budget prediction/allocation are known statements, not measured residuals.
Historical control allocations/predictions exist; no validated magnetic pointing/hold result. Detumble trajectory and ideal direct-torque pointing do not establish tracking accuracy.
Relative mounting intent and conflicting knowledge requirements can be listed. Released full optical/body transforms, calibrated residuals and thermoelastic error are missing.

Requirement limits and vendor sync capability are known separately. Small-angle sensitivity delta-theta approximately omega*delta-t can be evaluated for declared hypothetical conditions; actual clock/latency/error distribution is unknown.
Error-budget structure and dependencies can be defined; no combined HS-2 pointing value or accepted confidence distribution is supported.

answers.question: Which terms can currently be quantified?
answers.answer: Only vendor component specifications, documented requirement/allocation candidates, and conditional sensitivities. None of the six terms has an independently validated installed HS-2 performance value.

answers.question: Which terms are completely blocked as flight predictions?
answers.answer: Estimator residual and bias drift, installed sensor/optical alignment, control tracking, real timing error and the combined total all lack required evidence; no flight error distribution is selected.

answers.question: Which uncertainties are likely to dominate?
answers.answer: Potentially consequential: raw-sensor versus tracker-feedback policy; gyro bias/drift over unaided intervals; contaminated magnetic data; coarse Sun response/coverage; optical alignment and sample-age errors. This is engineering risk ranking, not a numerical variance ranking. Existing budget assertion that control dominates is not independently established.

answers.question: Enough evidence for attitude KNOWLEDGE accuracy?
answers.answer: No. No current complete estimator, approved metric, installed error model or independent synchronized validation.

answers.question: Enough evidence for CONTROL pointing accuracy?
answers.answer: No. Estimator, hardware/magnetic validity, geometry and magnetic pointing/hold validation remain open.

answers.question: Enough evidence for TOTAL payload pointing accuracy?
answers.answer: No. Terms, frames, timing, confidence, correlations and inclusion boundaries are not closed; do not RSS unmatched assumptions.
